source_workflows.source_description: Use to design or revise an organization-specific incident-response playbook with triggers, severity, roles, evidence handling, containment choices, communications, recovery, metrics, and exercises. Align current NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 with CSF 2.0 where applicable. Do not invent organizational authority, contacts, approvals, or system capabilities.

Use to create evidence-aware malware-incident communications for executives, technical teams, legal/privacy, customers, regulators, or vendors. Trigger when the user needs initial, update, containment, recovery, or closure templates. Preserve uncertainty and avoid declaring attribution, breach, eradication, or impact before evidence supports it.

Use to plan, approve, or execute containment in an authorized AWS, Azure, or GCP incident: identity, keys, network, workloads, data, logging, evidence, communications, and recovery. Live actions require connected cloud APIs and explicit account/resource scope. Prefer reversible controls, preserve evidence, and define stop/rollback conditions.

transformation: Portable instruction-first consolidation. Original scripts, binaries, source snapshots, test fixtures, and platform-specific execution artifacts are not included.
